_comment: 'If an item you control has been destroyed this turn, this gets go again.' plus a separate Galvanize defence trigger. The go again clause was hung off ON_DEFEND, which is the OTHER half of the card -- this half is not a defend trigger at all, so it fired at the wrong time and, being triggered, left the printed GoAgain unconditional. WHILE_STATIC + SOURCE_IS_ATTACK per CR 6.2.3d. The DESTROYED_THIS_TURN condition was already correct and is kept; Galvanize is untouched.
